_comment: PLAN.md D1-D4, D8 and CLASS-MAP.md sections 1, 5 and 6 (first draft, TUNE). The source of truth for the class
table and the lineage: tools/build-classes.py copies it into data/SKSE/Plugins/NjordlingerCombatGameplayOverhaul/
and the plugin build fills each class's form IDs (ability, global, keyword) from NjordlingerCombatGameplayOverhaul.esp.
Names and descriptions here are the English text; the page shows the translated NJ_ClassName_<id> /
NJ_ClassDesc_<id> strings from Interface/Translations when they exist.
tier: 0 Novice (the three starts), 1 Apprentice, 2 Adept. Expert and Master are two rank paths each (rank perks,
authored later); Legendary is a title reached by finishing its questline (titles below).
groups: the skill groups the class holds; a hybrid's second group opens when it is chosen and never closes again.
extraSkills: single skills held outside the groups (the Archer line keeps Archery while Q21 puts Archery in warrior).
next: the two options offered at the next upgrade. reachable=false: defined but on no lineage in this draft.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: A fighter of steel and shield. Holds the warrior skills and smithing. Health regenerates faster.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: A student of the five schools. Holds the magic skills and enchanting. Magicka regenerates faster.

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: Quick hands and a quiet step. Holds the covert skills and alchemy. Moves faster while sneaking.

classes.name: Knight
classes.description: Armour and discipline. Resists a little of every weapon and spell.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Raw strength. Power attacks hit harder.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: Raw arcane power. A chance to absorb hostile spells.

classes.name: Healer
classes.description: The restoring hand. Dual-cast Restoration costs less.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: Death from the shadows. Sneak attacks deal more damage.

classes.name: Archer
classes.description: The patient bow. Moves faster while drawing a bow, and keeps Archery.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description: Steel and faith. Opens the magic skills. Blocking resists arrows and spells.

classes.name: Blademaster
classes.description: Mastery of the blade. Weapon attacks cost less stamina.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.description: Rage made flesh. Deals more damage while badly hurt.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A blade with no code. Opens the covert skills. Power attacks hit harder with an empty off hand.

classes.name: Battlemage
classes.description: Spell and steel together. Opens the warrior skills. Wards resist weapon damage.

classes.name: Occultist
classes.description: Forbidden lore. Summoned and raised servants last longer.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Sworn to the Divines. Restoration spells are stronger against the undead.

classes.name: Nightblade
classes.description: Shadow and spell. Holds both the magic and the covert skills. Illusion is stronger while undetected.

classes.name: Burglar
classes.description: No lock holds. Lockpicking and pickpocketing are easier.

classes.name: Scout
classes.description: Far ahead of the column. Opens the warrior skills. Stamina regenerates faster.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.description: Tracker and trapper. Keeps Archery; arrows hit harder against animals.

classes.name: Spellsword
classes.description: Destruction costs less with a weapon drawn.

classes.name: Witchhunter
classes.description: Potions last longer.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: Poisons last for more hits.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Fights unarmed and unarmoured with extra armour.

ranks._comment: Expert (tier 3) and Master (tier 4): two rank paths each, chosen once. Each path grants the rank perk listed by class later (rankPerks); none is authored yet.

titles.name: Archmage
titles.description: Master of the College of Winterhold.

titles.name: Listener
titles.description: The voice of the Night Mother.
